atoms.b: Bessie made her disappoint((++ment ation)) about the taste of the sauce very clear.
Polly believed educa((++tion ness)) was the most valuable thing in the world.
Laura couldn’t wait to tell her friends all about her engage((++ment cian)) to Ben.

instruction.text: Listen to the word carefully and build it using the word parts below.

hint.text:
If a word ends 'te' we get rid of it and add 'tion'. For example, 'educate' becomes 'education'.

If a word ends with a 'd', 'de', 'se' or 't' then we usually get rid of those letters and add 'sion' or 'ssion'. For example, 'decide' becomes 'decision'.

If the word we want to make is a job, then we usually add 'cian'. For example, 'music' becomes 'musician'.
